# MD Work

> MD Work is a free Android app that tracks work days, earnings and expenses for people paid by the day or by the hour. Everything stays on the phone: no account, no cloud, works offline. Free on Google Play, translated into 28 languages.

## Facts

- App: MD Work (package `app.mdwork.notebook`)
- Developer: MD Nexa (MOHAMED YASSINE HAJ, Italy), mdnexa9@gmail.com
- Platform: Android 7.0 and up
- Price: free, supported by ads
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.mdwork.notebook
- Website: https://mdnexa9.github.io/Ta7mil11/
- Privacy policy: https://mdworkprivacypolicy.vercel.app/
- Data deletion: https://mdnexa9.github.io/Ta7mil11/#delete-data
- Languages: 28, including Arabic with right-to-left support
- Currencies: EUR, USD, GBP, TND, AED

## What it does

MD Work is a work notebook for daily and hourly workers: it records a full day, a half day, days off or exact hours, computes earned, spent and remaining for the month, and shows everything on a month calendar. Expenses can be one-time or recurring, payments can be marked unpaid, partly paid or settled, and the month can be shared as a report image, a CSV file or plain text. Quick tools add notes, a work timer, checklists, tables and reminders. Backups are exported to a local file and restored on a new phone.

## Who it is for

Construction, agriculture, cleaning, delivery, hospitality and other daily or hourly paid work where income changes every month and no employer portal keeps the record.
